risk_note: RV2 (apps/api/src/modules/commission, new module). Real rebate quoter implementing catalog's CardRebateQuoter: RuleSetReader keyed by appId only (Kysely, reads only this module's three tables, returns every published, unrevoked version of the app); version chosen in memory as the latest effective_from <= the quote instant (BR-CALC-11, to the second); incomplete versions rejected through @couli/domain validateRuleVersion (BR-CALC-06/07/05); viewer level L1 for guests, identity createUserLevelReader for users; N from union quoteN, own share from @couli/domain quoteRebate (BR-CALC-20); taobao price_compare_risk lower bound recomputed at rate x compare_rate_ratio_bp (BR-PRICE-07); 0 -> no_rebate (BR-PRICE-08); every failure rejects, never 0. Quote instant taken before any port read (live) or at prepare (scoped), so a version that becomes effective, or is revoked, while reading is never used. prepare() keeps process-wide state and must not be wired in production (B2-03d does not; follow-up). Rule tests: reader.int.test.ts comment mechanically reworded (test-guard), [AC-B2-03c#31] changed and [AC-B2-03c#45] added by the orchestrator per the orchestrator decision (option A, BR-CALC-20), no assertion removed.
